name: Marlon Lim Cinense
specialty: Colored Realism, Black & Grey Realism, Neotrad
bio: Co-founder and head artist of Palawan Tattoo Studio, Marlon Lim Cinense is a DOH-certified tattoo artist whose mastery spans black & grey realism, traditional, and neo-traditional styles. With years of competition experience both locally and internationally, Marlon has established himself as one of Palawan's most decorated and respected tattoo artists.
achievements: Multiple Local & International Tattoo Competition Winner

name: Arlong Zapanta
bio: Co-founder of Palawan Tattoo Studio and a seasoned tattoo artist, Arlong Zapanta brings exceptional skill in realism, color portraits, and Japanese-style tattooing. His creative vision and technical precision have helped shape the studio's identity and reputation for world-class artistry.

name: Jemuel Ferrer
specialty: Tribal Polynesian, Pilipino Tribal, Fine Line
bio: Jemuel Ferrer is a versatile and detail-oriented tattoo artist specializing in geometric patterns, dotwork, and fine line tattoos. His precise technique and artistic sensibility make him a sought-after artist for intricate and minimalist designs.

name: Bryan Cinense
specialty: Fine line, Minimalist black and Grey
bio: Bryan Cinense is a talented tattoo artist with a strong command of black & grey work, lettering styles, and old school tattooing. His bold lines and clean shading have earned him a loyal clientele who appreciate timeless tattoo aesthetics.

name: Duke
bio: Duke is a master of tribal, blackwork, and Polynesian tattoo traditions. His deep understanding of cultural motifs and bold blackwork techniques create powerful, statement tattoos that honor ancient art forms while maintaining a modern edge.

name: Hades Osiris
bio: Hades Osiris brings a dark, cinematic edge to tattooing with a specialty in horror-themed art, dark realism, and neo-traditional designs. His unique artistic vision and dramatic compositions have made him one of the most distinctive voices in Palawan's tattoo scene.

name: Alyssa Grace Cinense
bio: Alyssa Grace Cinense is a multi-talented artist specializing in watercolor tattoos, delicate florals, and fine line work, as well as DOH-certified body piercing. Her soft, painterly approach and meticulous attention to detail bring a unique feminine elegance to the studio's artistic portfolio.
